g.text: From window updates to a continuous scope trace
Example: 2,000 samples/s, 400 rows per window, one channel shown
Window update rate depends on stride.
What a downstream scope appends at each update
Elapsed plotted time (ms); same scale in both rows
*Overlap trimming is enabled only when the visualization is given both rates.
Scope time step = 1 / plotted sample rate; screen refresh is separate.
Without an explicit sample rate: plotted rate = publish rate × rows fed to scope.
Example: one feature row at 20 updates/s → 20 points/s → 50 ms per point.
Sliding Window's own scope plots its input; the examples above concern downstream windows.
